lean.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι],
  ∀ (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ), A.IsHermitian → ∀ s : ℝ,
    0 < Matrix.trace (NormedSpace.exp (s • A)) ∧
      Matrix.trace (NormedSpace.exp (s • A)) ≤
        (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * Real.exp (|s| * ‖A‖)
approved_definition_context: A finite matrix type Matrix ι ι ℝ is the real square-matrix algebra; multiplication is matrix multiplication. Fintype supplies a finite enumeration and DecidableEq supplies equality decisions. Nonempty asserts that the index carrier has at least one element.
Matrix.IsHermitian means conjugate transpose equals the matrix; over ℝ this is transpose equality. Matrix.trace is the ordinary sum of diagonal entries without division by the dimension.

NormedSpace.exp is the power-series exponential in the matrix algebra, whereas Real.exp is scalar exponential. The notation ‖A‖ uses Matrix.Norms.L2Operator, the operator norm induced by the Euclidean norm.
The scalar s ranges over ℝ; |s| denotes the real absolute value. Matrix scalar multiplication multiplies every entry by the displayed scalar.
